includedPullRequests.title: Update submodules; pin G7SensorKit to feat/trio-g7-direct
includedPullRequests.body:
Routine submodule refresh. All 16 pins are at the tip of their tracked branch.

| Submodule | Branch | Old → New |
| --- | --- | --- |
| LoopKit | `trio` | `f974241` → `ff8c30e` |
| LoopAlgorithm | `main` | `4604ee3` → `7ef6724` |
| EversenseKit | `dev` | `e1bb6fa` → `e7a1850` |
| OmnipodKit | `dev` | `928bb79` → `0c6d68b` |
| G7SensorKit | `feat/trio-g7-direct` | `5c0fc07` → `e99d631` |
| CGMBLEKit | `dev` | `ea224e7` → `776543f` |
| DanaKit | `dev` | `e157a86` → `eadb9fe` |
| MedtrumKit | `dev` | `ef866fa` → `c336995` |

- **G7SensorKit** — flag any unusable reading as a sensor issue
- **OmnipodKit** — shared signal-loss test, simplified PKA view
- **EversenseKit** — 365: retry `GetTxCertificate` with inverted tx_flags
- **LoopAlgorithm** — per-prediction-point correction range, emulation options
- **CGMBLEKit / DanaKit / LoopKit / MedtrumKit / OmnipodKit** — lokalise translations, 22 Oct round (string catalogs only; LoopKit's pbxproj diff is a pure re-sort — 918 build-file entries before and after, none added or removed)

Also pins G7SensorKit to `feat/trio-g7-direct` in `scripts/define_common_trio.sh`. It said `main`, which disagreed with `.gitmodules` — a scripted refresh would have dropped the direct-G7 integration.

### LoopKit carries a Core Data model change

LoopKit includes *Share next-dev's Core Data model* (#649), moving LoopKit's model from v4 to v8 with mapping models and migration code. **It never runs in Trio.** Nothing in Trio or any plugin instantiates a LoopKit `PersistenceController`; the stores all require one injected, and the only construction sites in LoopKit are its own tests and example app. Trio uses its own `TrioCoreDataPersistentContainer`.

Verified by running the pre- and post-bump builds against an identical restored container (~26.7k glucose rows): record counts match, the app launches clean, no LoopKit `Model.sqlite` is created, and the migration log lines never appear — though both strings are present in the shipped binary. A `find` across all simulators located a LoopKit store only for a separately installed Loop app, confirming the check would have found one.

No removed public API in any bump. The sync alert APIs that the G7 direct integration and LibreLoop's compat branch depend on are unchanged at the new LoopKit tip.

includedPullRequests.title: Record the CC0 licence for the alarm sounds
includedPullRequests.body:
Adding Creative Commons license for the new Trio alarm sounds.
Quoting from the updated alarm sound file package we received:

> **License**
> I am the author of the attached files in _mild-medium-harsh sets_ and _One-offs-.
> I have the right to license them, and they contain no third-party material I cannot license. I license them under the Creative Commons Zero license for inclusion in Trio. I also grant Dan / the project maintainers permission to distribute them under any later license adopted by the project. I wish to remain anonymous; please credit me as "An anonymous diabetes dad and Trio user" or not at all.
